description: This file defines the EvidenceService class responsible for managing evidence packages, including creation, retrieval, integrity verification, and linking to approvals. It implements mechanisms for cryptographic hashing, artifact storage, and audit logging for tamper-evidence.

classes.name: EvidenceError
classes.description: Custom exception class used for errors related to evidence handling.

classes.name: EvidenceService
classes.description: Main service class providing methods to create, retrieve, verify, and link evidence packages with audit support.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_evidence_package( self, submission_id: str, package_id: str, package_version: str, evidence_items: List[Dict[str, Any]], actor_user_id: str = "system", actor_role: str = "system", correlation_id: str = "", )
methods.description: Creates an evidence package with associated artifacts, computes hashes, stores files, and logs the creation event.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_evidence_package(self, evidence_package_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves an evidence package and verifies its integrity by comparing stored hash with computed hash.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_evidence_artifact(self, artifact_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves an artifact and verifies data integrity via hash comparison.

methods.name: None link_evidence_to_approval( self, evidence_package_id: str, approval_record_id: str, actor_user_id: str, actor_role: str, correlation_id: str, )
methods.description: Creates an audit linkage between an evidence package and an approval record.
